summary: Full re-derivation against fingerprint eb7d4ec4. The 2026-08-07 13/13 result was treated as prior claims to re-test, not a baseline: every criterion was re-derived and two moved. 13/13 PASS. Suite 340 passed. THE BUILD IS SOUND; THE RECORD IS AGAIN WHAT NEEDS WORK. One NEW drift the register had not held: spec L1122 says 'Three checks record a non-pass row on every run' and cites docs/data_quality_framework.md § 7, which has said TWO since task-069/DEC-016 fixed data_type_consistency on 2026-08-12 — the spec contradicts its own cited source.
